title: My Neighborhood
text:
I live on a quiet street. My neighborhood has a small park with big trees. There is a bakery on the corner. The bread is always warm.

Every Saturday, my neighbors play music in the park. My friend Ana has a dog named Max. Max likes to run after the ball. I like my neighborhood very much.

questions.text: What is on the corner of the street?
What is the name of Ana's dog?
How does the writer feel about the neighborhood?
options: They do not know it well

questions.text: Why do the neighbors probably like the park?
options: It is a place to spend time together
It is far from their homes

vocabulary.definition: a shop where bread and cakes are made and sold
a public green space where people can relax and play

paragraph_translations: Vivo en una calle tranquila. Mi barrio tiene un parque pequeño con árboles grandes. Hay una panadería en la esquina. El pan siempre está caliente.
Cada sábado, mis vecinos tocan música en el parque. Mi amiga Ana tiene un perro llamado Max. A Max le gusta correr detrás de la pelota. Me gusta mucho mi barrio.
